note.question: Does forcing all remanufacturing to be authorized improve economic and environmental outcomes relative to laissez-faire, once an OEM, an independent remanufacturer, and an upstream supplier respond strategically?
note.overview: The model is a multistage supplier–OEM–remanufacturer game solved by backward induction under mandatory authorization and laissez-faire regimes.

coverage.note: The existing independently audited model map was decomposed into Mini-style components and linked back to the page-preserving source extraction.
